name: CK Solution
summary: Established in 2004 and headquartered in Yongin-si, South Korea, CK Solution Co.,Ltd. specializes in advanced HVAC&R (heating, ventilation, air conditioning, and refrigeration) technologies and facility construction. The company offers a diverse range of products, including dehumidifiers, precision air conditioning units, VOC concentrators, BCUs, air showers, air handling units, condensing units, electric heat pumps, clean room equipment, and chillers. They cater to various critical environments, providing solutions for dry room, clean room, HACCP and GMP compliant, precision air conditioning, low-temperature storage, and environmental plant systems. Their comprehensive services further extend to mechanical, HVAC&R, utility, and special facility construction, HVAC equipment supply and installation, COE/FED business management, industrial facilities design engineering, and dedicated customer support.
